{{Quote|We have located the enemy's shield generator facility, but were unable to approach. It is heavily guarded.|Hemdil Tre|<ref name="Date1" />}}
After the end of their [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] around [[3636 BBY]], the [[Eternal Empire]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] built a '''shield bunker''' atop a rocky spire in [[the Wound]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to support the [[Tatooine Star Fortress|Star Fortress]] that they placed in geosynchronous orbit above the bunker.<ref name="Resistance" /> Commanded by [[ZK-163M]], an elite [[Skytrooper]], the bunker and its [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] was protected by powerful defensive emplacements, [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], and [[Eternal Empire trooper]]s.<ref name="Destroy" /> Around [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date2" /> [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]&mdash;leader of an [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against Zakuul&mdash;rallied the local resistance against the Eternal Empire<ref name="Resistance" /> and organized a bombardment of the bunker, allowing the Outlander and the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Leyta]] to infiltrate and destroy the bunker and thus expose the [[Star Fortress]].<ref name="Destroy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The shield bunker on Tatooine was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a 2015 Digital Expansion.
